SELECT c.name AS client_name, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales
FROM companyx.clients c
JOIN companyx.sales s ON c.id = s.client_id
WHERE c.region = '서울'
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 5
SELECT SUM(amount) FROM companyx.sales WHERE quarter = '2025-Q3'
SELECT AVG(s.amount) FROM companyx.sales s JOIN companyx.products p ON s.product_id = p.id WHERE p.category = 'security'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companyx.contracts WHERE status = 'active'

SELECT e.name, e.salary
FROM companyx.employees e
JOIN companyx.departments d ON e.dept_id = d.id
WHERE d.name = '기술지원팀'
SELECT c.name FROM companyx.clients c JOIN companyx.projects p ON c.id = p.client_id WHERE p.status = 'in_progress' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES
SELECT title, description FROM companyx.support_tickets WHERE priority = 'critical' AND status NOT IN ('resolved', 'closed')
SELECT p.name AS product_name, SUM(c.amount) AS total_contract_amount FROM companyx.products p JOIN companyx.contracts c ON p.id = c.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companyx.clients WHERE registered_at >= '2024-01-01' AND registered_at < '2025-01-01'
SELECT d.name, AVG(e.salary) AS avg_salary FROM companyx.departments d JOIN companyx.employees e ON d.id = e.dept_id GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY avg_salary DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES
SELECT d.name AS department_name, COUNT(e.id) AS employee_count FROM companyx.departments d JOIN companyx.employees e ON d.id = e.dept_id GROUP BY d.name
SELECT name FROM companyx.employees WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM hire_date) = 2022 ORDER BY hire_date ASC
SELECT e.position, COUNT(e.id) AS employee_count FROM companyx.employees e GROUP BY e.position ORDER BY employee_count DESC
SELECT name, industry, region FROM companyx.clients WHERE company_size = 'enterprise'
SELECT registered_at FROM companyx.clients WHERE name = 'Client-AC'
SELECT c.name FROM companyx.clients c WHERE c.region = '부산' AND c.industry LIKE '%IT/SW%' AND c.is_active = true
SELECT name FROM companyx.products WHERE status = 'beta'
SELECT p.name, p.price_monthly FROM companyx.products p ORDER BY p.price_monthly DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES
SELECT contract_type, COUNT(*) FROM companyx.contracts GROUP BY contract_type
SELECT c.name, ct.amount FROM companyx.clients c JOIN companyx.contracts ct ON c.id = ct.client_id WHERE ct.status = 'cancelled' ORDER BY ct.amount DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companyx.projects WHERE status = 'in_progress'
SELECT name, budget FROM companyx.projects WHERE budget >= 10000
SELECT category FROM companyx.sales WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sale_date) = 2026 AND quarter = '2026-Q2' GROUP BY category ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_sales, SUM(amount) AS total_amount
FROM companyx.sales
JOIN companyx.products ON companyx.sales.product_id = companyx.products.id
WHERE companyx.products.category = 'consulting'

SELECT s.sale_date, s.amount
FROM companyx.sales s
JOIN companyx.contracts c ON s.contract_id = c.id
JOIN companyx.clients cl ON s.client_id = cl.id
WHERE cl.name = 'Client-B' AND s.sale_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companyx.support_tickets WHERE assignee_id = (SELECT id FROM companyx.employees WHERE name = '임우진')
SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM companyx.support_tickets st JOIN companyx.clients c ON st.client_id = c.id WHERE st.title LIKE '%SSL 인증서 만료%'
SELECT AVG(resolved_at - created_at) AS avg_resolution_time FROM companyx.support_tickets WHERE status = 'resolved'

SELECT e.name AS employee_name, e.position, d.name AS department_name
FROM companyx.employees e
JOIN companyx.departments d ON e.dept_id = d.id
WHERE e.position = '이사'
SELECT s.amount, s.sale_date FROM companyx.sales s JOIN companyx.products p ON s.product_id = p.id WHERE p.name = 'Product-D3' ORDER BY s.amount DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES
